title: Sforza side to Giorgio (Zorzo) del Maino, reply, 4 May 1446 (BnF italien 1583 f. 68; DECODE R7898)

documents.shelfmark: BnF italien 1583 f. 68 (Archivio Sforzesco); DECODE R7898
documents.route: Sforza's camp or chancery -> Giorgio del Maino (probably at Milan)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the slip or on DECODE; Mazzatinti 1883 gives only the heading 'Risposta a quanto ha riferito Zorzo Maino (4 maggio). In cifre.'

transcription.source: Authenticated DECODE image IMG_R7898_I35637_P.png (binarized scan, slip c. 1850 px wide)
transcription.notes: Draft only: diacritic variants (dotted c, d with apostrophe, barred g) merged; several signs uncertain. Clear Lombard Italian between the cipher runs.

documents.shelfmark: BnF italien 1583 f. 70; imaged in DECODE R7899 (image P1, the slip at top right)

plaintext.source: No decipherment; Mazzatinti: 'Lettera di Vincenzo Amidani a Fr. Sforza (Milano 4 maggio). In cifre.'

transcription.notes: Draft only; a different hand with the same sign family as f. 68; sign equivalences between the two hands not certain.

system.summary: Graphic-sign cipher of the Sforza chancery type: letter signs with homophones, probably signs for vowel+consonant syllables, word signs and nulls (inferred from the related Simonetta-Amidani key, ASMi Sforzesco 1597 no. 14). The actual key is not found.

prior_solution.where: Mazzatinti's 1883 inventory lists it as 'in cifre' with no reading; no edition or decipherment found

conditions.human_role: Selected the target; the DECODE session cookie was supplied earlier.
tools: DECODE authenticated image and API download

solution.what: Downloaded the DECODE R7898 image with the saved cookie; dated in clear M cccc xlvj die iiij may (4 May 1446), mixed clear Lombard Italian and graphic cipher.

Mazzatinti's inventory of BnF ital. 1583-1593 (Archivio storico lombardo X, 1883): f. 68 = reply to what Zorzo Maino reported, in cipher; f. 70 = Vincenzo Amidani to Sforza, Milan 4 May, in cipher. No reading printed.
Draft transcription of f. 68: 404 signs, 26 types after merging diacritic variants.

Homophonic annealing with it-cinquecento, clear text as context: unconstrained, capped homophones, nulls allowed, then one-to-one swaps (solver verified on a 400-letter synthetic cipher). All nonsense or degenerate.
Word-pattern search on repeats (FpBHcdSp x2, 8zBprJFp x2, xJpg x4): FpBHcdSp fits 'uisconti' but the other repeats contradict that key.
Found f. 70 (Amidani, same day, same sign family) on DECODE R7899 image P1; transcribed 390 signs; annealing on it alone also gives nonsense.

Downloaded all 208 Sforza key records on DECODE (ASMi Carteggio Sforzesco cart. 1591, 1597, 1598) and scanned them at thumbnail size; read the headings and alphabets of the 15th-c. copies (cart. 1597 nos. 2-36). 1597 no. 14 (18th-c. copy, 'Angelus cum cifra Vincentij', shared with Stavoli, Augustinus, Baptista, Matheus, Vincentius) is the same family: homophones, vowel+consonant syllable signs, word signs (de = cross-circle, ot = divide sign), nulls. Its letter signs do not match the frequent signs of f. 68 or f. 70. 1597 no. 17 (1447, Sforza's envoys to Alfonso) does not match either.

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only annealing, word patterns and all 208 Sforza key records on DECODE were tried on f. 68 and its sibling f. 70; the syllabic Sforza-type system gave no reading.
outcome.notes: Closed unread. Syllabic Sforza-type system on a binarized scan; needs the 1446 Maino key or a better image and a sign-exact transcription.
